model_identity_import.root_line_convention: The32 four-coordinate roots are projective lines normalized firstcoordinate1. In the standard monomial realization, the G(4,2,4) orbit of (1,1,1,1) consists of128 vectors with coordinates powersof i and even exponent sum; quotienting its four scalar phases gives32 lines. This does not count the full G31 vector orbit.
